title: The Horizon — MANIFEST
status: Design numbers for implementation. Control points are centreline intent to be solved into splines by the land pass; not navigation or collision data until baked into WorldDefinition v3. v1.7: paces and surface grip (RIDE D42) — data only, no geometry change.

units.scale: engine units = concept metres × scale.factor (see scale)

island.note: Closed smooth curve through these points (Catmull-Rom). Shore is 12 m of sand/rock stroke; shallows extend 50 m.

offshore.label: The Lamp

offshore.label: The Needle's Eye

offshore.label: The Wreck

landformRule: polygons are clipped to the island outline; the Hollow, the Stillwater terrace and the Cup are cut INTO the Shoulder (their own band wins inside them); elsewhere where polygons overlap the innermost (higher) band wins; band edges blend over 60 m; a bed (road, skate, rail, walk) overrides the bands within its profile width + 15 m each side and holds its own grade limits, so band steps never appear as cliffs on a route

stillwater.note: natural lake; never encodes money; ice Jan–Feb

cup.note: tarn; paper-boat and River Run launch

wash.note: dry streambed on the Flats; runs only after almanac rain; the Wash skate bowl at [465,700]

spring.note: a decorative spring at the Reach; not the Deep's outflow

hostRule: footprint_m is the building's plan (w × d, concept metres, scales); roofH_eu is ridge height above its ground in engine units (does not scale)

hosts.label: The Fund bank

profileRule: widths and lengths of routes scale with scale.factor (they are concept metres); clearances, gauges, rises and anything sized to the body or a vehicle are engine units and never scale

walkable.note: the body cannot climb steeper than 38°; a lip above 0.5 eu is an edge, not a step

skateMain.note: grades apply to the bed after the land pass solves it; S1 averages ~15 % with real gravity

cable.note: clear_eu never scales; spacing is concept metres

stone.note: threshold pads, station slabs and the Tideline park

flow.meaning: banked or boarded ground that wants a carve

threshold.meaning: every pad and the square: stops a board arriving under ~4.6 m/s in a pad's 6 m

n/a.note: not a bed for this mover; the kernel's offbed class applies (roll 6.0, pushGrip 0)

G1.label: Gondola

ZIP.label: Zipline
ZIP.note: the Prow tower (30 m tower, deck at h 100) → Long Sands 44 m inland, skirting the town's west edge over the Reach; at 1 % sag it overflies no roof, clears V01 by 9 m, S1 by 23 m, the Reach walk by 26 m, and crosses above the gondola cable at [1442,921] with 10.7 m between cables

ORE.label: Ore Line
stations: the South Portal [1345,680] h110 (29 m from Crown Road's turning circle)
ORE.note: climbs after the Deep inside the rock, leaves the footprint at [1398,576] and runs a 119 m tunnel to the South Portal

FERRY.label: The Ferry
FERRY.note: clockwise (north up: west along Long Sands, in and out of the Bight under the bridge, round the Lamp and the Wreck, up the west, along the north, down the Prow, home); doubles back at the Bight pier
FERRY.boarding: walk the gangway (the deliberate action); the Ferry waits 20 s at each pier

ROW.label: Rowboat / canoe / dinghy water
ROW.area: the Bight, the harbour, the coast to the Sea Door, the river below the Notch, the Deep
ROW.range: the Wreck is reached only by Ferry (it slows there)

RIVER_RUN.label: River Run (canoe)
RIVER_RUN.note: starts at the lake inlet [1160,740] (the Cup's outflow is a 62 % cascade, scenery only) → lake → dam portage → Notch → Reach → harbour

DEEP_RUN.label: Deep Run (canoe)
DEEP_RUN.drop: the Steps: 3 × 12 m chutes in the first 120 m; then level to the sea
DEEP_RUN.note: the underground river through the Sea Passage; out under the Prow into daylight, then paddle round to the Landing

highSpan.gate: Ring Run gate 3 under the deck at h 16

apronBridge.under: the tailrace below the dam and the River Run

bightBridge.under: the Ferry (twice per lap), Ring Run gate 5

hollowBridge.note: a covered footbridge, not on Green Road; the ninth disc-golf basket; S4 rail if you dare

dam.gallery: stair in the east abutment from the apron to the crest, past the plaques (does not enter the Undercroft)

inletFootbridge.under: the upper river at the lake inlet

duneCulvert.note: a dune tunnel; the last surprise before the sand

southPortal.note: Ore Line top station, 29 m from the turning circle, 20 m from the Crown walk

zipPlatforms.topNote: deck of a 30 m tower at the Prow; the glider launch is the same deck
zipPlatforms.landingNote: a landing tower on the dune crest, deck 8 m above the Town Weave boardwalk which passes beneath it; a stair and a ramp down to the sand

landingQuay.note: the race finish on the islet between the Reach's west channel and the river; 25 m run-out along the bank; kerb-separated from V01 which passes 45 m south; the Boathouse dock is across the west channel by the Reach boardwalk

townQuay.note: Lantern Row, 8 m inside the waterline; pedestrian; the floatplane dock at its east end

throat.note: a diving entry: 139 m of sloping throat at 30° down to the Deep at h 40; flare over the water

seaDoor.passage: the Sea Passage: a 504 m boat tunnel from the Deep to the sea, glow-worm lit, with the Steps (three 12 m chute drops in the first 120 m; the Deep Run rides them down like a flume; reduced motion cuts them). Upstream travel: boats tie up at the foot of the Steps [1420,505] and a portage stair (threshold stepsFoot) climbs beside the chutes to the Deep's jetty; nobody paddles up. The Sea Door pier has a cliff stair (the Sea Stair) up to the Prow walk, and the Ferry as its step-free way back

southPortal.note: the Ore Line's top; a walk-in door too

footprint.note: all rooms inside; doors on its rim or reached by a listed tunnel

skylight.note: opens on the north slope; sun shaft when the sun is above 20°

bellGallery.note: directly under the summit; the bell rope is 68 m

damGallery.note: a stair inside the dam's east abutment from the apron to the crest past the plaques; it does NOT enter the Undercroft

green.note: the Drop Zone target is ground paint inside the protected centre; S4 passes 60 m west

gates.note: under the deck (deck h 24, riverbed h 8)

balloon.note: the Look camera made physical; you ride it up and back down, there is no stepping out at the top

damRun.note: 514 m to the arch with 115 m of height in hand at a 9:1 glide; the Reach meadow is 130 m past the High Span

throatRun.note: out over the north sea, turn, dive in

lampHop.land: the Bight water beside the sandbar (fade to the sandbar)

journeys.note: Straight-segment lengths between control points at assumed speeds; calibration estimates, not measured journeys. at_active_scale uses the confirmed scale.factor (1.0); the two at_factor tables are comparison scenarios.

targets_s.note: Original design targets retained after D13 selected 1.0. Pass 1 reports measured pass/fail against these targets; scale approval does not waive them or change speeds.

yearWalk.note: a trail through the twelve stations in calendar order, reusing existing walks and trails where they coincide; link segments authored in pass 1; the walk ahead of the current month is dressed as stakes and string

stretch.rule: a month is the stretch of the Year Walk from the previous station to its own; one paving stone per day (28–31); every seventh stone a flagstone with a lantern post; the camp stands on today’s stone; scheduled items stand on their stone as explicit markers (slip, pennant, stake, chairs); the next stretch is stakes and string until its month begins
markers: bill slip on a post (name, amount)

station.identity: site(monthOrdinal) = station(month) + bed(yearIndex); appending never moves a bed
station.waymark: post with the month name and the year count; lit at the camp

camp.rule: the current month’s bed: lit waymark + tent card; the camp card docks to it on the map
camp.moves: on Chapter/books close; 1 s card animation, a cut under reduced motion

eraGates.rule: a gate (two posts + lantern) on the Year Walk at the bed where the era ended; lantern from the existing finish rules

names.idRule: ids are camelCase keys in this manifest (e.g. highSpan, plot.terraces.1); display names above are their labels; STYLE and the guide map use labels, code uses ids

scale.rule: engine_units = concept_metres × factor, applied to x, y and height alike; speeds in m/s are engine units per second
scale.why: Jonathan selected full concept scale. Journey estimates use factor 1.0; the 0.6 table remains a comparison scenario, not the active scale.
scale.decision: D13 — Jonathan: “1.0 — full concept scale”, confirmed 2026-09-25; applies to x, y and height.

crossingRule: crossings contains physical resolutions only (over, under, threshold) at authored point, corridor or area locations; Pass 1 resolves these into numeric WorldDefinition geometry. District metadata belongs to its crossing. routePairNotes preserves coordination evidence for Pass 1 verification, including shared plan points; it never exempts a computed intersection from the crossing register.

routePairNotes.note: the South Portal [1345,680] is 29 m from the turning circle; a path links them
routePairNotes.verification: Verify the South Portal link against the built Crown Road turning circle; register any actual intersection found in Pass 1.

routePairNotes.note: the Sea Passage leaves the Deep east; the rail leaves north-east and climbs; separated by 20 m of rock
routePairNotes.verification: Both centrelines include [1300,420] at the Deep. The original 20 m rock-separation note describes the departing passages, not proven clearance at this shared point. Pass 1 must compute their vertical profiles and register and build every actual crossing; this note is not an exclusion.
